reports.title: Loi organique n° 2018-29 du 9 mai 2018, relative au Code des Collectivités Locales
reports.publisher: Assemblée des Représentants du Peuple, Tunisie
reports.description: Tunisia's foundational municipal/regional finance code, verified directly via full-text download. Art. 131: "L'Etat s'engage, à travers les lois de finances, les lois fiscales et les lois relatives aux biens, à ce que, progressivement, les ressources propres représentent la part déterminante des ressources de chaque collectivité locale." Art. 132 enumerates ressources propres: local taxes (per Art. 65 of the Constitution), shared/transferred tax product, shares of impôts partagés, penalties, redevances, non-fiscal revenue, and "la quote-part des collectivités locales au titre de la régularisation, de la péréquation et de la solidarité". Art. 61 creates the Haute Instance des Finances Locales (HIFL) under the tutelle of the Haut Conseil des collectivités locales, tasked to "promouvoir l'autonomie financière des collectivités locales et de réduire les disparités entre elles", propose transfer-allocation criteria to the State budget, and issue opinions on local-finance questions.
reports.cadence_note: One-off foundational legal instrument, currently in force.

reports.title: Résumé exécutif du deuxième rapport annuel de la Haute Instance des Finances Locales (2020)
reports.publisher: Haute Instance des Finances Locales (HIFL), Tunisie
reports.description: HIFL's own second annual report (covering 2017-2020), verified directly. Quantifies the national transfer-to-own-resources ratio: "لم تتجاوز نسبة التحويلات للجماعات المحلية من إجمالي الموارد الذاتية لميزانية الدولة منذ عدة سنوات، عتبة 3%" [The share of transfers to local governments out of the state budget's own total resources has not exceeded a 3% threshold for several years]. Reports two of its own composite indices for 2020: "بلغ مؤشر الاستقلالية لكافة الجماعات المحلية % 37,3 خلال سنة 2020" [the autonomy index for all local governments reached 37.3% in 2020] and "تراجع مؤشر اللامركزية لكافة الجماعات المحلية ليبلغ % 4 سنة 2020" [the decentralization index for all local governments fell to 4% in 2020]. Also notes local-government expenditure as a declining share of state-budget expenditure (excluding debt service), down to 4.9% by 2020.
reports.cadence_note: Annual report; this is the second edition, covering results for 2017-2020.

reports.title: Rapport de mission — Accompagnement des communes en difficultés financières: Commune Ezzouhour, Gouvernorat de Kasserine
reports.publisher: Portail des Collectivités Locales (collectiviteslocales.gov.tn), Tunisia — mission conducted with SKL International
reports.description: A named-commune fiscal-distress diagnostic hosted on Tunisia's own official local-government portal, verified directly. Quantifies the commune's structural dependency: "تمثل تحويلات الدولة أكثر من 92% من موارد العنوان الأول فيما لا تتجاوز الموارد الذاتية 7,27%" [State transfers represent more than 92% of Title I (operating) resources, while own resources do not exceed 7.27%]. A four-year table (2017-2020) shows state transfers rising in absolute terms (2,627,348 TND to 5,052,134 TND) while own-resource shares of Title I revenue stayed in the single digits throughout the period (ranging roughly 4-7%) — one of the starkest single-commune fiscal-dependency ratios found in this branch to date.
reports.cadence_note: One-off diagnostic mission report, not a periodic publication.

reports.title: Bilans comparés au 31 décembre 2024 — Caisse des Prêts et de Soutien des Collectivités Locales (CPSCL)
reports.publisher: Caisse des Prêts et de Soutien des Collectivités Locales (CPSCL), Ministère de l'Intérieur, Tunisia
reports.description: CPSCL's own comparative balance sheet, verified directly (a downloaded financial-statement PDF, in French, hosted on CPSCL's own site). Confirms CPSCL's active lending role to Tunisian local governments with real figures: "Prêts en cours de réalisation" (loans being disbursed) 18,083,815 TND (2024) vs. 23,507,195 TND (2023); "Prêts en cours de remboursement" (loans being repaid) 293,342,332 TND (2024) vs. 307,684,982 TND (2023); "Fonds de dotation" (endowment fund) held constant at 86,161,054 TND both years; "Immobilisations financières" (financial fixed assets) 311,788,558 TND (2024) vs. 331,617,692 TND (2023). CPSCL separately publishes its own annual procurement plans (marchés publics) approved by its Conseil d'Administration, confirming ongoing institutional operation into 2025.

dependencies.basis: HIFL is itself created by Article 61 of the Code des Collectivités Locales ("Il est créé, sous la tutelle du Haut Conseil des collectivités locales, une Haute Instance des finances locales..."), and its own annual report is the institutional product of that statutory mandate.
